name.ja: プラノサウルス モササウルス

description.ja: 恐竜の骨格・外皮をひとつひとつ確かめながら自分で組み立て、自分の手で恐竜を“知りつくす”ブランド『プラノサウルス』から、白亜紀の海の支配者「モササウルス」が登場！
description.en: From Planosaurus, a brand that allows you to assemble and get to know dinosaurs by checking each dinosaur's skeleton and skin one by one, comes the Mosasaurus, the ruler of the Cretaceous seas!

description.ja: • 「骨格ビルド」で恐竜の内部構造から知ることができる。
description.en: • "Skeleton Build" allows you to learn about the internal structure of dinosaurs.

description.ja: • 「恐竜ビルド」で骨格の上から外皮パーツを取り付けるプラモデルならではの仕様でモササウルスの姿を復元。
description.en: • "Dinosaur Build" allows you to restore the appearance of the Mosasaurus by attaching the outer skin parts to the top of the skeleton, which is unique to plastic models.

description.ja: • ニッパー等の道具や接着剤が必要ないから簡単に組み立てられる。
description.en: • Easy to assemble as there is no need for tools such as nippers or adhesives.

description.ja: • 特徴的な上顎の前後2列の歯並びを再現。
description.en: • Reproduces the characteristic two rows of teeth in the front and back of the upper jaw.

description.ja: • 海棲爬虫類である、モササウルスはイグアナやオオトカゲのような細かな鱗で覆われていたとされ、きめ細かい繊細な皮膚の造形を表現。
description.en: • The marine reptile Mosasaurus is said to have been covered with fine scales similar to those of iguanas and monitor lizards, giving it a detailed and delicate skin structure.

description.ja: • 泳ぐ姿のまま飾ることが出来るディスプレイ台座が付属。
description.en: • Comes with a display pedestal that can be displayed while swimming.

description.ja: • 口の開閉やヒレ、首や尾など各所が可動し、泳ぐ姿が再現可能。
description.en: • Various parts such as the opening and closing of the mouth, fins, neck and tail can be moved, allowing you to recreate the swimming appearance.
